# Test corpus

Generated by `scripts/make-pki.sh` then `scripts/make-fixtures.sh` with
c2patool 0.27.21 (c2pa-rs 0.90.21). Everything here is signed with the
**TEST ONLY** PKI in `pki/`, which no real validator trusts.

Each image `X` has two oracle files written by `scripts/oracle`, never edited by hand:

- `X.expected.json`: `c2patool X --detailed` with default trust. The test PKI
  is untrusted, so signed files show `signingCredential.untrusted`.
- `X.trusted.expected.json`: the same with `pki/trust-anchors.pem` trusted.

If c2patool fails, the file holds `{"c2patool_error": "...", "exit_code": N}`.
Load fixtures from Go with `internal/fixtures`.

## unsigned/

Generated by `scripts/genimages` (deterministic). Expected: c2patool `No claim found`.

| File | What |
|---|---|
| `small.jpg` | 64×48 gradient, no APPn segments |
| `exif.jpg` | `small.jpg` with a minimal APP1 Exif segment |
| `large.jpg` | 480×360 noise; its thumbnail makes the signed manifest span several APP11 segments |
| `small.png` | 64×48 gradient |
| `large.png` | 256×192 noise |

## signed/

All ES256, claim v2, `c2pa.hash.data` hard binding, auto thumbnail.
Expected state: `Valid` (untrusted) / `Trusted` (with anchors).

| File | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `small.jpg` | `small.jpg` | `c2pa.created`, digitalCapture; 1 APP11 segment |
| `exif.jpg` | `exif.jpg` | c2patool puts APP11 **before** the APP1 Exif segment |
| `large.jpg` | `large.jpg` | 7 APP11 segments |
| `titled-ts.jpg` | `small.jpg` | `dc:title`, `stds.schema-org.CreativeWork`, RFC 3161 timestamp (DigiCert); `timeStamp.untrusted` is informational |
| `edited.jpg` | `signed/small.jpg` as parent | 2 manifests; parent ingredient, `c2pa.opened` + `c2pa.color_adjustments` |
| `small.png` | `small.png` | `caBX` chunk |
| `large.png` | `large.png` | `caBX` chunk |
| `ts.png` | `small.png` | RFC 3161 timestamp |

## broken/

One defect each, made from `signed/small.*` by `scripts/mkbroken` (except `expired.jpg`).

Together with `ocsp/revoked.jpg` they are the negative set: tampered pixels,
bad signature, truncated manifest, expired certificate, wrong hash and revoked
certificate, each rejected by C2paSeal and by c2patool (`verify.TestNegativeSet`).
`scripts/mkbroken` is deterministic, so rerunning it rewrites the same bytes.

| File | Defect | Oracle result |
|---|---|---|
| `data-flip.jpg` | 1 bit flipped in JPEG scan data | `assertion.dataHash.mismatch` |
| `data-flip.png` | 1 bit flipped in IDAT, CRC fixed | `assertion.dataHash.mismatch` |
| `sig-flip.jpg` | last byte of the COSE signature flipped | `claimSignature.mismatch` |
| `assertion-flip.jpg` | `c2pa.created` → `c2pa.createD` in the actions assertion | `assertion.hashedURI.mismatch`, `assertion.action.malformed` |
| `truncated-app11.jpg` | file cut halfway through the APP11 segment | c2patool error: could not parse JPEG |
| `bad-jumbf-length.jpg` | `c2pa.assertions` superbox LBox set to 0x7FFFFFF0 | c2patool error: claim superbox not found |
| `expired.jpg` | signed by a 90-second leaf cert that has since expired, no timestamp | `signingCredential.expired` |
| `wrong-hash.jpg`, `wrong-hash.png` | 1 bit flipped in the hash stored in `c2pa.hash.data` (image untouched; PNG CRC fixed) | `assertion.hashedURI.mismatch`, `assertion.dataHash.mismatch` |
| `sig-flip.png` | last byte of the COSE signature flipped, CRC fixed | `claimSignature.mismatch` |
| `truncated-cabx.png` | file cut halfway through the `caBX` chunk | c2patool error: PNG out of range |

## samples/

Put public C2PA sample files here (`.jpg`/`.png`) and rerun
`go run ./scripts/oracle testdata` to add their oracle output.

## remote/

Manifest stores kept outside the file. Generated separately by
`scripts/make-remote-fixtures.sh` (c2patool 0.27.21), which regenerates only
this directory; the oracle runs with `remote/served/` served on
`http://127.0.0.1:8765/`. Expected state: `Valid` / `Trusted`.

| File | Store | c2patool flags |
|---|---|---|
| `embedded-remote.jpg`, `embedded-remote.png` | embedded, and also referenced from XMP `dcterms:provenance` | `-r <url>` |
| `sidecar.jpg`, `sidecar-png.png` | only in `sidecar.c2pa` / `sidecar-png.c2pa` next to the file | `-s` |
| `remote.jpg`, `remote-png.png` | only at the XMP URL; the store is in `served/` | `-s -r <url>` |

Tests serve `served/` without a network port (`fixtures.RemoteClient`);
`go run ./interop` serves it on 127.0.0.1:8765.

## legacy/

C2PA 1.x files (claim v1), generated separately by
`scripts/make-legacy-fixtures.sh`, which regenerates only this directory.

From the public c2pa-rs test corpus (`sdk/tests/fixtures`, commit
`f67921a6ee069878d15db9ff601bf5babcefdff6`, each file checked by SHA-256 in
the script). c2pa-rs is dual-licensed MIT OR Apache-2.0. These are signed
PS256 by c2pa-rs's own test PKI (or by Adobe for `ocsp.jpg`), so they are
untrusted in both oracle modes.

| File | What | Oracle result |
|---|---|---|
| `C.jpg` | v1, `sigTst` time-stamp (DigiCert) | Valid; `timeStamp.trusted` (c2pa-rs skips TSA trust for v1) |
| `CA.jpg` | v1 with an ingredient without provenance | Valid; `ingredient.unknownProvenance` |
| `CACA.jpg` | v2 over a v1 chain, `sigTst2` | Valid; `timeStamp.untrusted` |
| `CIE-sig-CA.jpg` | v1 whose ingredient's signature was bad when it was added | Valid (the failure is recorded in the ingredient assertion) |
| `E-sig-CA.jpg` | v1 claim edited after signing | Invalid: `claimSignature.mismatch`, `timeStamp.mismatch` |
| `XCA.jpg` | v1, image data changed | Invalid: `assertion.dataHash.mismatch` |
| `adobe-20220124-E-clm-CAICAI.jpg` | c2pa-rs 0.16: text `x5chain` header, ingredient label edited | Invalid: `ingredient.manifest.missing`, `assertion.hashedURI.mismatch` |
| `legacy_ingredient_hash.jpg` | c2pa-rs 0.16: pre-1.3 ingredient hash over the claim bytes | Valid |
| `ocsp.jpg` | Adobe Photoshop/Firefly, stapled OCSP responses, 1.x credentials store | Valid |
| `prerelease.jpg` | pre-1.0 store | c2patool error: Prerelease claim found |

Written by c2patool 0.27.21 with the TEST ONLY PKI and `"claim_version": 1`:

| File | What | Expected state |
|---|---|---|
| `v1.jpg`, `v1.png` | v1 claim, ES256, `c2pa.created` | Valid / Trusted |
| `v1-edited.jpg` | `v1.jpg` re-signed as parent, v1 ingredient | Valid / Trusted |

`cloud.jpg` from the same corpus was left out: its store is only at an Adobe
URL, so its oracle output would depend on that server.

## ocsp/

`small.jpg` signed by C2paSeal with each OCSP test signer (`pki/ocsp/`),
with the TEST ONLY responder's answer stapled in the COSE unprotected header
(`rVals`). c2pa-rs reads stapled responses but does not write them, so
c2patool is the oracle, not the signer. Made by `scripts/make-ocsp-fixtures.sh`.
The responder chains to the test root, so the responses count only in the
trusted mode.

| File | Stapled answer | Default oracle | Trusted oracle |
|---|---|---|---|
| `good.jpg` | good | Valid (response ignored) | Trusted, `signingCredential.ocsp.notRevoked` (informational) |
| `revoked.jpg` | revoked | Valid (response ignored) | c2patool error: the certificate is not trusted |
| `unknown.jpg` | unknown | Valid (response ignored) | Trusted (an unknown stapled answer is not reported) |
